values.comments: Betrothal reading of Genesis 19:14: the sons-in-law are engaged to the two daughters who leave with Lot. Two is the explicit daughter count in 19:8 and 19:15.

values.parents: Job (both families; mothers not jointly identified)
values.sons: seven unnamed sons in each of two families
values.daughters: three unnamed daughters in the earlier family; Jemimah, Keziah, Keren-Happuch in the later family
values.comments: Counts both birth cohorts; the narrative does not establish the same mother for both. This changes the observation scope, not just the estimate.

values.source: Mahabharata, Adi Parva, Sambhava Parva, sections XCVIII-XCIX (Kisari Mohan Ganguli translation); https://sacred-texts.com/hin/m01/m01099.htm; https://sacred-texts.com/hin/m01/m01100.htm
values.comments: Counts only the son who survives Ganga's drowning of the earlier seven. This changes the scope from births to survivors of that episode.
Counts only the four named sons in the Chronicles genealogy. Excludes the earlier unnamed infant in 2 Samuel 12; this is a scope change, not a denial of that birth.
